name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.landing.read.SpeechVoiceReadPaperListActivity
description: For an advertiser offer with a reading plan, the Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK shows the advertiser, total reading reward, and a reader panel where users follow assigned articles and track task progress.
disableEffect: Blocking it removes the reading-plan offer and article flow, so users cannot complete its ad task or receive the reading reward.
